keep.123: Line 213: class attribute value '参数列表' on #paramList. It must match the CSS selector .参数列表 in the <style> block (line 11). Style blocks are not records, so that selector will never be translated; translating this attribute breaks the parameter-list grid styling.
keep.243: Line 2021: the template builds <div class="参数项"> rows for #paramList. The class name must match the CSS selectors .参数项, .参数项 span and .参数项 b at lines 11, 33 and 55, which are not records and stay Chinese. The ${r[0]}/${r[1]} placeholders are the only other content, so the whole literal should stay verbatim.
keep.252: Line 2041 only (exportJson): '当前方案' is an enumerated value of the Chinese key 模式 in the exported 城市退火设计方案.json. A reader of his export format that tests 模式 would break. Only used in the export, so keeping it costs no on-screen text.
keep.253: Line 2041 only (exportJson): 'Top-K高精度最终方案' is an enumerated value of the exported key 模式, the same case as id 252. Only used in the export.
keep.254: Line 2041 only (exportJson): '历史最优' is an enumerated value of the exported key 模式, the same case as id 252. Only used in the export.
keep.255: Line 2041 only (exportJson): `Top-${TOP_K_FINAL} 高精度重排序完成` is the 'done' status value of the exported key 最终复核, the counterpart of id 256. A reader checking the re-rank status would break. Only used in the export.
keep.256: Line 2041 only (exportJson): '尚未执行高精度重排序' is the 'not done' status value of the exported key 最终复核, the counterpart of id 255. Only used in the export.
keep.190: Lines 2020 and 2041: '内置场地' is the fixed marker written as the value of the exported key 场地来源 when no Rhino file was used (otherwise the value is the file name), so a reader could test for it. Borderline: the same record is also the on-screen parameter-list label at line 2020. Keeping it leaves that one label in Chinese. Drop it from the keep list if an English label matters more than export fidelity.
